title: ACQ: A Deployed Two-Stage Framework for Automated Creative Quota Allocation in Large-Scale Online Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2412.06167v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In digital advertising, demand-side platforms (DSPs) allow advertisers to create multiple ad creatives from a single photo for real-time bidding. While increasing the number of creatives can improve bidding opportunities, it cannot scale indefinitely, and the incremental advertising revenue typically exhibits diminishing returns as more creatives are generated. This raises a practical problem for DSPs: how to automatically determine an appropriate creative quota for each photo at scale. To address this problem, we propose Automated Creatives Quota (ACQ), a deployed two-stage framework for creative quota allocation in large-scale online advertising. translated_title: ACQ：一种部署的大规模在线广告自动化创意配额分配两阶段框架
translated_abstract: 在数字广告中，需求方平台（DSP）允许广告主从单张照片创建多个广告创意以进行实时竞价。虽然增加创意数量可以提高竞价机会，但无法无限扩展，并且随着创意生成数量的增加，增量广告收入通常会呈现递减回报。这给DSP提出了一个实际问题：如何在规模上自动为每张照片确定合适的创意配额。为解决这一问题，我们提出了自动化创意配额（ACQ），一种用于大规模在线广告中创意配额分配的已部署两阶段框架。在第一阶段，ACQ使用基于不平衡二叉树构建的多任务模型预测配额条件下的预期收入，该模型旨在处理跨配额级别的高度偏斜收入分布。在第二阶段，ACQ在全局容量约束下形式化配额分配问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ACQ的已部署两阶段框架，通过基于不平衡二叉树的多任务模型预测配额条件下的收入，并优化全局容量下的配额分配，从而在大规模在线广告中自动化确定每张照片的创意配额，以平衡收益与成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ACQ, a deployed two-stage framework that predicts quota-conditioned revenue using a multi-task model on an unbalanced binary tree and optimizes quota allocation under global capacity, enabling automated creative quota determination for each photo in large-scale online advertising to balance revenue and cost.
